name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri's journey into motorsport began in his youth, inspired by the roar of engines at local rally events near his hometown. He initially pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, intending to work directly on car design, but quickly found his passion lay in the strategic and organizational aspects of racing. After graduating, he took on various roles in smaller racing teams, from coordinating logistics to assisting with race strategy. 

Dimitri's approach to the sporting director role is rooted in meticulous planning and clear communication. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member understands their role and works towards a common goal. While still developing his management skills, he brings a fresh perspective and a keen eye for detail. 

What sets Dimitri apart is his relentless pursuit of improvement, both for himself and the team. He's eager to learn from experienced colleagues and implement innovative strategies to gain a competitive edge, ensuring the team is always striving for peak performance.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed to the side with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Dimitri is of average height with a slightly stocky build, and always sports a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down observations and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking black tea at precisely 10:00 AM every day.
